svg.title: F-DRAWING · Two observation records
svg.desc: Drawing P is an oval with a smaller oval inside. Drawing Q has a similar layout but occupies more width and height on the page. Apart from P, Q and the observation-drawing caption, no measurements or other labels are printed.
